name: AI Assistant
description: Floating AI support chat assistant for the admin dashboard and frontend, proxied through the internal Art INPA AI Gateway.
author: Art INPA

menus.name: AI Assistant
menus.description: AI Assistant admin settings and full chat page.

ai-assistant.chat.send.description: Proxy a user support chat message to the internal AI Gateway.

ai-assistant.chat.history.description: Load the current user or guest session AI Assistant conversation history.

ai-assistant.chat.close.description: Delete the current user or guest session AI Assistant conversation when the chat is explicitly closed.

ai-assistant.widget.inject.description: Inject the floating AI Assistant widget into allowed frontend and admin HTML responses.

ai-assistant.message.sent.description: Fires after a chat message is stored and sent to the AI Gateway.

ai-assistant.message.received.description: Fires after an AI response is stored.
